Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 21.0 ng/mL, prior negative biopsy, evaluate for focal lesion.
FINDINGS: The prostate measures 112.15 mL in volume. T2-weighted imaging shows a mildly heterogeneous peripheral zone. Diffusion-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of restricted diffusion in the left posterior peripheral zone, approximately 8 mm in diameter, with corresponding mild enhancement on dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymph nodes or bone lesions are seen.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 3 lesion in the left posterior peripheral zone. PSA density 0.19 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.4009605.
